issues.description: The 18 source contracts are mapped, but most exact routes, live readability and history remain unverified. Frozen catalog metadata identifies candidate CRSP.DSF and IBES detail/summary tables with matching named fields, but no row probe or period coverage; COMP.FUNDA lacks lpermno/state/linkdt/linkenddt/sic from the author's merged input; SDC.JOINT_VENTURES does not expose the author's wide participant fields; TFN.S34 lacks instown_perc. Remaining patents/citations, broker events, TNIC2, SIC2, inventor links, common ownership and link/history inputs have no verified compatible route in this assessment. No access barrier is established.

The IBES-CRSP link producer saves ibes_ibes_crsp_link_processed.Rdata, while expertise loads .ibes_ibes_crsp_link_processed.Rdata. No matching leading-dot producer appears in the supplied code; the ordinary-basename working-copy correction is supported by the exact producer/consumer contract.

The substantial R program is embedded in a 3,875-line PDF text extraction, begins with an empty setwd(), and contains automatic package-install setup. R 4.5.0 is present but all 17 author-listed packages are absent from installed.packages metadata. It needs faithful extraction/reflow, a configured root and explicit package preparation before a future authorized run.

Use a prepared compatible route where the supported local/public product already meets the contract; otherwise retain the original raw-preparation branch and record the remaining specific access or field gap.

validation: Confirm every required input has a compatible supported route or a specific unresolved field/history/access item.

review_notes: Full source reading covers all 130 datasheet lines, 3,875 code-extraction lines and 809 appendix lines. The PDF contains substantial R code even though the initial static parser reported zero code parser IDs.
The static trace records 18 raw files, 59 producer-backed RData files and 116 source I/O events; a separate consumer-only leading-dot IBES path is preserved as a handoff issue.
The patent CSV contract uses literal xi and does not interpret it as an inventor measure. inventor_id is from the separate patent-inventor TSV.
Local frozen catalog metadata is discovery evidence, not a live row read or historical-coverage test. Candidate routes remain unverified; no data outcome is forced.
identifiers.csv supplies pair-year PERMNO identifiers, not an analysis panel. No analysis_only shortcut or absent Oster estimator branch is inferred.
No author R code, model or estimator was run; no RData/RDS or other executable serialized object was loaded; no package was installed, no data downloaded, no contact made and no patch applied.
